title: Oscillations: Simple Harmonic Motion
note: Take g = 10 m/s² unless stated otherwise.

questions.question: Which of the following expressions of force corresponds to simple harmonic motion along a straight line, where x is the displacement and a, b, c are positive constants?
A simple harmonic motion is represented by equation $\frac{d^{2}x}{{dt}^{2}} + \alpha x = 0$. What will be the time period of this motion?
The function $\sin^{2}(\omega t)$ represents:

options.A: a periodic, but not simple harmonic, motion with a period $\frac{2\pi}{\omega}$
options.B: a periodic, but not simple harmonic, motion with a period $\frac{\pi}{\omega}$
options.C: a simple harmonic motion with a period $\frac{2\pi}{\omega}$
options.D: a simple harmonic motion with a period $\frac{\pi}{\omega}$

questions.question: A body is in simple harmonic motion with time period half second (T = 0.5 s) and amplitude one cm (A = 1 cm). Find the average velocity in the interval in which it moves from equilibrium position to half of its amplitude.

A particle executes SHM given by the equation $x = A\sin (\frac{2\pi}{T}t + \phi)$. It is at position $- \sqrt{3}A/2$ at time t = 0 and moving away from the mean position. Find the phase constant and the time taken by the particle to reach the mean position.

A particle is performing SHM along $x$-axis with origin as the mean position and time period of T and amplitude of A. What will be the minimum time between two successive appearances of the particle at $+ \frac{A}{2}?$
A simple harmonic motion is represented by the equation $y = A\sin (12\pi t + \frac{7\pi}{6})$. Find the time when it reaches $+ A$ for the first time.
A particle of mass m moves on the x-axis according to the equation, x = 2 + 4 sin 4πt. Choose the INCORRECT option:

options.A: The particle is undergoing SHM with x = 2 as the mean position
options.B: The amplitude of its oscillations will be 4 units
options.C: The number of times the particle is at x = 0 in 1 second is 2.
options.D: The particle reaches x = 0 for the first time at t = $\frac{7}{24}$s.

questions.question: A 1 kg block attached to a spring vibrates with a frequency of 1 Hz on a frictionless horizontal table. Two springs identical to the original spring are attached in parallel to an 8 kg block placed on the same table. The frequency of vibration of the 8 kg block is:

Two identical springs of spring constant 2k are attached to a block of mass m and to fixed supports. When the mass is displaced from the position of equilibrium, it executes SHM. The time period of the oscillation is?
questions.think_further: What would be the time period if the springs were not attached to the block? Answer: $2\pi\sqrt{m/2k}$
